items.difficulty_reason: The counted statement shows that the space of a locally Noetherian decent algebraic stack is sober (author lemma at source lines 10559-10563, label lemma-decent-locally-noetherian-sober). The proof (source lines 10565-10572) collects local Noetherianity, the Kolmogorov property and quasi-sobriety from three earlier results and reads off sobriety from the definition (proof lines 10565-10572). The assembly of the three ingredients through the definition of sobriety is the substance. H3.
